answer: Issue each proven agent one unlinkable credential per epoch using blind signatures: after verified useful work, the agent gets a single-use token proving eligibility without revealing identity. Reusing a token cryptographically exposes the spender, so one agent cannot pose as many. Like a dune crossing where each traveler leaves one track, a single summit path, or a meadow gate admitting one flock at a time, influence is capped per verified identity. Faking identities means repeating the costly verified work for every token, making Sybil farms uneconomical while honest agents stay private.
